title: fold-check subcommand: 73 lines of new harness code have zero automated coverage and are absent from CI
detail: New subcommand with four exit-code paths (arg-count/parse fail=2, short-dump=1, splice match=0, mismatch=1) and a byte-splice at offset 33. No @(test) exists in harness/ (grep empty) and ci-local.sh's 10 GATES omit fold-check, so nothing re-runs it.
recommended_fix: Add a harness self-test asserting exit codes 0/1/2 and splice-offset correctness, and wire `fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` into tools/ci-local.sh GATES.

title: W9 campus-half floor hardcodes literal 10 instead of deriving from the catalog like the newly-derived EXPECTED
evidence:
EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
...
	testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
		"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
data/demand.json: campus entry volume 1, surge set_piece multiplier 10.
detail: N5 made EXPECTED derive (stream_entries × multiplier × WINDOW), but the campus floor keeps a magic 10 (= campus volume 1 × multiplier 10). A re-tune of campus volume or surge.multiplier drifts EXPECTED/MIN_LAND yet leaves the campus pin at 10 — the derive-don't-hardcode contract is only half-applied.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor too: campus_volume × surge.multiplier × WINDOW × 95/100, from the campus streaming entry's volume and surge.multiplier.
